trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: User provides lead ID and asks for possession date.
steps.text: Hello, నాకు ఎక్కువ time లేదు. LD-1003 నా lead ID. 'Sunrise Towers' లో keys exactly ఎప్పుడు ఇస్తారు? నాకు ఒక date కావాలి.
తప్పకుండా అండి. ముందుగా మీ details verify చేయడానికి, మీ registered name లేదా pincode చెప్పగలరా?
నా పేరు Suresh అండి, నాకు meeting ఉంది త్వరగా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the requested project.
Provide possession quarter and RERA ID.
steps.text: Sunrise Towers, RERA ID PRM/KA/RERA/123 లో 3BHK possession Q4 2024 లో ఉంటుంది అండి. మేము exact date promise చేయలేము.

steps.purpose: User insists on exact date and requests a morning site visit.
steps.text: నాకు September 1st కి కావాలి. సరే, నాకు time లేదు, రేపు morning site visit book చేయండి. నేను అక్కడే మాట్లాడుకుంటాను.

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule site visit for morning.
Inform unavailability and ask for alternative time.
steps.text: రేపు morning slots లేవండి. Afternoon కానీ evening కానీ try చేయమంటారా?
Evening చూడండి. దొరికితే అదే ఫిక్స్ చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule site visit for evening.

steps.text: మీ site visit రేపు evening కి book అయింది. మీ executive Raju, reference number VR-999. ఇంకేమైనా details కావాలా?

steps.purpose: User ends call without requesting an SMS.
steps.text: చాలు, thank you. నేను రేపు వెళ్తాను.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end conversation without forward guarantees.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant attempts to schedule a site visit, encounters an unavailable slot, retries with a different time of day, and immediately exits the loop to confirm the booking once the tool returns a scheduled status.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: The assistant correctly grounds the possession quarter, RERA ID, and visit details in the tool outputs. However, it violates the negative constraint by promising an SMS will be sent after the call ends in e20.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The user requests an SMS in e19 and the assistant guarantees it will be sent in e20 ('SMS పంపిస్తాము'). This violates the 'Tool Output Grounding' variant's negative constraint against making guarantees about what happens after the call ends, as there is no tool or system confirmation to support this.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the user's utterance in e19 to end the call without asking for an SMS (e.g., 'చాలు, thank you. నేను రేపు వెళ్తాను.'). Update the assistant's response in e20 to simply thank the user and say goodbye without any forward guarantees.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the 'Loop Exit Detection' variant by retrying a failed booking and exiting upon success. It also adheres to business rules regarding possession claims and RERA disclosure. However, it fails the negative constraint of the 'Tool Output Grounding' variant by making an unsupported forward guarantee about sending an SMS after the call ends.

variant_findings.reason: The agent attempts to schedule a site visit for the morning, which fails (e12-e13). It then retries for the evening based on user input, which succeeds (e16-e17). The agent immediately exits the loop, confirming the successful booking without unnecessary further steps (e18).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses strictly in the tool outputs. In e18, it accurately quotes the executive name (Raju) and reference number (VR-999) from e17.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
